import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch from matplotlib.path import Path
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": "#263238", "axes.labelcolor": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", "lines.solid_capstyle": "round", })
ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786" light = "#D9E1E4" colors = ["#33658A", "#2A9D8F", "#D4A72C", "#9273B5"]
# All positions and vector entries follow omega = exp(2*pi*i/4). omega = 1j n = np.arange(4) basis = np.array([[omega ** (k * j) for j in n] for k in range(4)]) expected = np.array([ [1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 1j, -1, -1j], [1, -1, 1, -1], [1, -1j, -1, 1j], ], dtype=complex) if not np.array_equal(basis, expected): raise ValueError("The supplied fourth-root basis is inconsistent.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.9), facecolor="white")
fig.text(0.045, 0.925, "a", fontsize=13, weight="bold") fig.text(0.075, 0.925, "Fourth roots of unity", fontsize=14, weight="medium") fig.text( 0.075, 0.842, r"$\omega=e^{\,i\,2\pi/4}=i$", fontsize=13, )
fig.text(0.505, 0.925, "b", fontsize=13, weight="bold") fig.text( 0.535, 0.925, r"Exponential basis in $\mathbb{C}^{4}$", fontsize=14, weight="medium", ) fig.text( 0.535, 0.842, r"$u_k(n)=\omega^{kn},\qquad n=0,\,1,\,2,\,3$", fontsize=12, )
# Left panel: dimensionless real and imaginary coordinates. ax = fig.add_axes([0.045, 0.065, 0.405, 0.715]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.65, 1.76) ax.set_ylim(-1.43, 1.43) ax.axis("off")
theta = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 401) ax.plot(np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta), color=slate, lw=1.35, zorder=1)
for start, end in [ ((-1.42, 0), (1.48, 0)), ((0, -1.24), (0, 1.27)), ]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=9, linewidth=0.9, color=light, zorder=0, ))
ax.text(1.49, -0.15, r"$\mathrm{Re}$", fontsize=10, color=slate) ax.text(0.11, 1.24, r"$\mathrm{Im}$", fontsize=10, color=slate) ax.text(-0.10, -0.15, "0", fontsize=9, color=slate, ha="right")
positions = [(1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (0, -1)] for (x, y), color in zip(positions, colors): ax.scatter(x, y, s=62, color=color, edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.0, zorder=4)
ax.text(1.09, 0.12, r"$\omega^0=1$", color=colors[0], fontsize=12, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(-0.10, 1.15, r"$\omega^1=i$", color=colors[1], fontsize=12, ha="center", va="bottom") ax.text(-1.10, 0.12, r"$\omega^2=-1$", color=colors[2], fontsize=12, ha="right", va="bottom") ax.text(0, -1.17, r"$\omega^3=-i$", color=colors[3], fontsize=12, ha="center", va="top")
arc_theta = np.linspace(0, np.pi / 2, 80) arc_vertices = np.column_stack([ 0.46 * np.cos(arc_theta), 0.46 * np.sin(arc_theta), ]) arc_path = Path( arc_vertices, [Path.MOVETO] + [Path.LINETO] * (len(arc_vertices) - 1), ) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( path=arc_path, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=10, lw=1.25, color=slate, zorder=3, )) ax.text(0.45, 0.57, r"$\frac{2\pi}{4}=\frac{\pi}{2}$", fontsize=13, color=ink, ha="left", va="center") ax.text(1.10, -0.22, r"$\omega^4=1$", fontsize=10.5, color=slate, ha="left", va="top")
# Right panel: entries are ordered by n, with transpose denoting a column. right = fig.add_axes([0.535, 0.095, 0.435, 0.665]) right.set_xlim(0, 1) right.set_ylim(0, 1) right.axis("off")
right.text(0.98, 0.96, "Phase step", color=slate, fontsize=10, ha="right", va="center")
vector_labels = [ r"$u_0=\left[\,1\quad 1\quad 1\quad 1\,\right]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$u_1=\left[\,1\quad i\quad {-1}\quad {-i}\,\right]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$u_2=\left[\,1\quad {-1}\quad 1\quad {-1}\,\right]^{\mathsf{T}}$", r"$u_3=\left[\,1\quad {-i}\quad {-1}\quad i\,\right]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ] steps = [r"$0^\circ$", r"$90^\circ$", r"$180^\circ$", r"$270^\circ$"] row_y = [0.79, 0.56, 0.33, 0.10]
for k, (y, label, step, color) in enumerate( zip(row_y, vector_labels, steps, colors) ): right.text(0, y, label, fontsize=15, color=color, ha="left", va="center") right.text(0.98, y, step, fontsize=11, color=slate, ha="right", va="center")
